packageRules.description: Pin io.qdrant:client to 1.7.0 — the version compatible with langchain4j-qdrant 0.35.0. Newer clients (1.18.x) remove PointIdFactory.id(UUID) and CollectionInfo.getVectorsCount(), which breaks compile AND crashes at runtime against a live Qdrant (unit tests use the in-memory store, so CI won't catch it). Do NOT re-enable until langchain4j-qdrant is upgraded in lock-step.
